The '''Betha II Starport''' was a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Betha II]]. It boasted a number of [[Hangar/Legends|docking bays]] and the city surrounding the starport was carved into the cliffs of a chasm near the entrance.
